title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Benefit: Gift Card Valuation in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
The value of a Pocketwire Rewards gift card redemption depends on the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and the direct deposits it received within the last month.

## Rule

When the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit and received direct deposits totalling at least 3000 USD within the last month, the value is banded: the first 5000 points redeemed are valued at the gift card rate and every point beyond them at the gift card rate plus 0.10 cents. When the account does not meet that first condition but is on Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit and received direct deposits totalling at least the direct-deposit lift threshold, 500.00 USD on every Pocketwire Rewards tier, within the last month, the value is every point redeemed at the gift card rate plus a block bonus of 250 cents for every full 5000 points redeemed. Otherwise no such adjustment applies.

The value is worked out in US cents. The records read are the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and the direct deposit entries on that account's ledger. A date lies within the last month when it is later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Valuation by plan and deposits

| Plan of the linked personal account | Direct deposits within the last month | Valuation |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 3000 USD or more | banded |
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 500 USD or more, below 3000 USD | block bonus |
| Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime | 500 USD or more | block bonus |
| any of these four plans | below 500 USD | no such adjustment |
| Pocketwire Lite or Pocketwire Core | any amount | no such adjustment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical redemption of 12300 points at a gift card rate of 1.20 cents per point)

- Banded: 12300 points multiplied by 1.20 is 14760 cents; the 7300 points beyond the first 5000 add 7300 multiplied by 0.10, which is 730 cents; 15490 cents in all, 154.90 USD.
- Block bonus: 14760 cents, and 12300 points hold 2 full blocks of 5000, adding 500 cents; 15260 cents in all, 152.60 USD.
- A redemption of 4900 points under the banded valuation has no points beyond the first 5000 and so no extra cents.
